Intwari Stadium (English: ''Heroes' stadium'') is a multi-purpose stadium in Bujumbura, Burundi.  It is currently used mostly for football matches.  It was refurbished through a FIFA Forward-supported project and is a 15,000-capacity venue. It was formerly named after former Burundian prime minister and independence hero, Louis Rwagasore before being renamed on 1 July 2019.
